title: Antique 4x5 camera creates 20 micron photolithography masks: Super tiny tax form
summary: Ben Krasnow of Applied Science uses an antique 4x5 view camera to make high-resolution photolithography masks in a home shop. He photographs a poster-sized printout onto litho film to get features around 20 microns.
why: Cited as an accessible way to make lithographic masks at home, in threads about hobbyist chip fabrication.

quote.text: There is a great video on creating lithographic masks on Ben Krasnow's Applied Science channel
